                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਸ਼ੁੱਧ-ਪ੍ਰਜਨਨ ਪੌਦੇ (ਉਹ ਪੌਦੇ ਜੋ ਸਵੈ-ਪਰਾਗਣ ਹੋਣ 'ਤੇ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਇੱਕੋ ਜਿਹੇ ਲੱਛਣਾਂ ਵਾਲੀ ਸੰਤਾਨ ਪੈਦਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ) ਚੁਣੇ ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਇਹ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕੇ ਕਿ ਮਾਪਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਜੈਨੇਟਿਕ ਬਣਤਰ ਸਥਿਰ ਅਤੇ ਅਨੁਮਾਨਯੋਗ ਸੀ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਸ਼ੁੱਧ-ਪ੍ਰਜਨਨ ਪੌਦਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਨੇ ਮੈਂਡਲ ਨੂੰ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਕਾਰਕਾਂ ਦੀ ਦਖਲਅੰਦਾਜ਼ੀ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਫੁੱਲਾਂ ਦੇ ਰੰਗ, ਬੀਜ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਕਲ ਅਤੇ ਪੌਦੇ ਦੀ ਉਚਾਈ ਵਰਗੇ ਲੱਛਣਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਰਾਸਤੀ ਪੈਟਰਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਰੂਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੇਖਣ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਸ਼ਲੇਸ਼ਣ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਇਜਾਜ਼ਤ ਦਿੱਤੀ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਸ਼ੁੱਧ-ਪ੍ਰਜਨਨ ਪੌਦਿਆਂ ਨੇ ਮਾਪਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਲੱਛਣਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਰਿਵਰਤਨਸ਼ੀਲਤਾ ਨੂੰ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਮੈਂਡਲ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਸ਼ੀਲਤਾ, ਨਿਖੇੜ ਅਤੇ ਸੁਤੰਤਰ ਨਿਖੇੜ ਦੇ ਸਿਧਾਂਤਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਥਾਪਿਤ ਕਰਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਦਦ ਕੀਤੀ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਵਿਰਾਸਤੀ ਪੈਟਰਨਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੇਂਦ੍ਰਤ ਕਰਕੇ, ਮੈਂਡਲ ਜੈਨੇਟਿਕਸ ਦੇ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਨਿਯਮਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤਿਆਰ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਯੋਗ ਹੋਏ, ਜਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਿਖੇੜ ਦਾ ਨਿਯਮ ਅਤੇ ਸੁਤੰਤਰ ਨਿਖੇੜ ਦਾ ਨਿਯਮ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹਨ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਸ਼ੁੱਧ-ਪ੍ਰਜਨਨ ਪੌਦੇ:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • ਸ਼ੁੱਧ-ਪ੍ਰਜਨਨ ਪੌਦੇ ਖਾਸ ਲੱਛਣਾਂ ਲਈ ਹੋਮੋਜ਼ਾਈਗਸ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਜਿਸਦਾ ਮਤਲਬ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਲੱਛਣ ਲਈ ਇੱਕੋ ਜਿਹੇ ਐਲੀਲਜ਼ ਰੱਖਦੇ ਹਨ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • ਉਹ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਇੱਕੋ ਜਿਹੀਆਂ ਵਿਸ਼ੇਸ਼ਤਾਵਾਂ ਵਾਲੀ ਸੰਤਾਨ ਪੈਦਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਜੋ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਜੈਨੇਟਿਕ ਅਧਿਐਨਾਂ ਲਈ ਆਦਰਸ਼ ਬਣਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • ਉਦਾਹਰਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਮਨੀ ਜਾਂ ਚਿੱਟੇ ਵਰਗੇ ਨਿਰੰਤਰ ਫੁੱਲਾਂ ਦੇ ਰੰਗਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਮਟਰ ਦੇ ਪੌਦੇ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹਨ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਮੈਂਡਲ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਯੋਗ:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • ਗ੍ਰੈਗਰ ਮੈਂਡਲ ਨੇ Pisum sativum (ਮਟਰ ਦੇ ਪੌਦੇ) ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਕੇ 1856 ਤੋਂ 1863 ਤੱਕ ਪ੍ਰਯੋਗ ਕੀਤੇ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਸੱਤ ਲੱਛਣਾਂ ਦਾ ਅਧਿਐਨ ਕੀਤਾ, ਜਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੀਜ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਕਲ, ਬੀਜ ਦਾ ਰੰਗ, ਫਲੀ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਕਲ, ਫਲੀ ਦਾ ਰੰਗ, ਫੁੱਲ ਦੀ ਸਥਿਤੀ, ਫੁੱਲ ਦਾ ਰੰਗ ਅਤੇ ਤਣੇ ਦੀ ਉਚਾਈ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਸੀ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • ਮੈਂਡਲ' ਦਾ ਕੰਮ 1866 ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ਿਤ ਹੋਇਆ ਸੀ ਪਰ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਾਅਦ ਵਿੱਚ, 1900 ਦੇ ਆਸਪਾਸ ਮਾਨਤਾ ਮਿਲੀ, ਜਦੋਂ ਹੋਰ ਵਿਗਿਆਨੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਖੋਜਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਮੁੜ ਖੋਜਿਆ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਇਤਿਹਾਸਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵ:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • ਮੈਂਡਲ' ਦੀ ਖੋਜ ਨੇ ਜੈਨੇਟਿਕਸ ਦੇ ਖੇਤਰ ਲਈ ਆਧਾਰ ਤਿਆਰ ਕੀਤਾ, ਜਿਸ ਨੇ DNA, ਜੀਨਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਅਨੁਵੰਸ਼ਿਕਤਾ 'ਤੇ ਬਾਅਦ ਦੇ ਅਧਿਐਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਿਤ ਕੀਤਾ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਖੋਜਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਜੈਨੇਟਿਕ ਲੱਛਣਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਝਣ ਅਤੇ ਫਸਲਾਂ ਦੀ ਪੈਦਾਵਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ, ਦਵਾਈ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਇਓਟੈਕਨਾਲੋਜੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 20th ਸਦੀ ਦੇ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੈਂਡਲ' ਦੇ ਕੰਮ ਦੀ ਮੁੜ ਖੋਜ ਨੇ ਮਾਡਰਨ ਸਿੰਥੇਸਿਸ ਦੇ ਵਿਕਾਸ ਵੱਲ ਅਗਵਾਈ ਕੀਤੀ, ਜਿਸ ਨੇ ਜੈਨੇਟਿਕਸ ਨੂੰ ਵਿਕਾਸਵਾਦੀ ਸਿਧਾਂਤ ਨਾਲ ਜੋੜਿਆ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The correct answer is temperature remains constant.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Ohm’s Law states that the ratio of the potential difference (V) across a conductor to the current (I) flowing through it is constant, provided the physical conditions such as temperature remain constant. This constant ratio is the resistance (R) of the conductor.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Mathematically, Ohm’s Law is expressed as V = IR, where V is the voltage, I is the current, and R is the resistance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The law is valid only under the condition that the conductor's temperature does not change. Temperature variation can lead to changes in resistance, thereby affecting the relationship between voltage and current.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Ohm’s Law is widely applicable to linear conductors like metals, which obey the law under normal conditions. Non-linear conductors such as semiconductors and vacuum tubes do not follow Ohm’s Law.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Hence, the condition that temperature remains constant is essential for Ohm’s Law to hold true.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Important Factors Affecting Ohm’s Law:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Temperature: The resistance of most conductors increases with temperature due to increased electron collisions. For Ohm’s Law to remain valid, temperature needs to be constant.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Material of the Conductor: Ohm’s Law applies primarily to conductive materials like copper, silver, and aluminum, which exhibit linear behavior between voltage and current.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Physical Dimensions: The resistance of a conductor is directly proportional to its length and inversely proportional to its cross-sectional area.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Non-Ohmic Devices: Devices like diodes and transistors do not follow Ohm’s Law because their current-voltage relationship is non-linear.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Applications of Ohm’s Law:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Electrical Circuit Analysis: Ohm’s Law is used extensively to calculate voltage, current, and resistance in circuits.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Designing Electrical Devices: It helps in designing resistors, voltage dividers, and current limiters.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Power Distribution: Ohm’s Law is crucial in determining the efficiency of power transmission systems.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Characteristics of Resistance:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Unit: Resistance is measured in ohms (Ω).

"solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The correct answer is Magnification = v/u.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Magnification is a measure of how much larger or smaller the image of an object appears compared to the object itself.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The formula for magnification is given by: M = v/u, where:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • M is the magnification,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • v is the image distance (distance of the image from the optical center),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • u is the object distance (distance of the object from the optical center).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Correct Option: Magnification = v/u.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Magnification can be:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Positive: When the image is upright (virtual image).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Negative: When the image is inverted (real image).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Other options like Magnification = u + v, Magnification = v × u, and Magnification = u/v are incorrect as they do not represent the correct mathematical relationship.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Magnification and Image Formation:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Magnification tells us about the relative size of the image compared to the object.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If |M| > 1, the image is magnified (larger than the object).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If |M| < 1, the image is diminished (smaller than the object).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If |M| = 1, the image is of the same size as the object.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Nature of the Image:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • For convex lenses, a real and inverted image has a negative magnification.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • For concave lenses, a virtual and upright image has a positive magnification.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Lens Formula: The magnification formula is closely related to the lens formula: 1/f = 1/v - 1/u, where f is the focal length of the lens.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Applications of Magnification:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Used in microscopes, telescopes, and magnifying glasses to enlarge small objects.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Essential in optics for designing lenses and optical instruments.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Understanding Incorrect Options:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Magnification = u + v: This is mathematically incorrect as magnification depends on the ratio of image and object distances, not their sum.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Magnification = v × u: This is also incorrect as there is no product relationship between v and u in magnification.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Magnification = u/v: This is the inverse of the correct formula and does not represent the actual relationship.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Important Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Sign Convention in Optics:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Distances measured against the direction of incident light are negative.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Distances measured in the direction of incident light are positive.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Height of the image is positive if it is above the principal axis and negative if below it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Practical Implications:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Magnification helps in designing optical instruments like cameras, projectors, and eyeglasses.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • It is a critical factor in medical imaging systems like endoscopes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                सही उत्तर है आवर्धन = v/u।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                मुख्य बिंदु

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • आवर्धन एक माप है कि किसी वस्तु का प्रतिबिम्ब स्वयं वस्तु की तुलना में कितना बड़ा या छोटा दिखाई देता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • आवर्धन का सूत्र इस प्रकार दिया गया है: M = v/u, जहाँ:\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • M आवर्धन है,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • v प्रतिबिम्ब दूरी है (प्रकाशिक केंद्र से प्रतिबिम्ब की दूरी),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • u वस्तु दूरी है (प्रकाशिक केंद्र से वस्तु की दूरी)।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • सही विकल्प: आवर्धन = v/u।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • आवर्धन हो सकता है:\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • धनात्मक: जब प्रतिबिम्ब सीधा हो (आभासी प्रतिबिम्ब)।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ऋणात्मक: जब प्रतिबिम्ब उल्टा हो (वास्तविक प्रतिबिम्ब)।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • अन्य विकल्प जैसे आवर्धन = u + v, आवर्धन = v × u, और आवर्धन = u/v गलत हैं क्योंकि वे सही गणितीय संबंध का प्रतिनिधित्व नहीं करते हैं।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                अतिरिक्त जानकारी

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • आवर्धन और प्रतिबिम्ब निर्माण:సరైన సమాధానం ఆవర్ధనం = v/u.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ఆవర్ధనం అనేది ఒక వస్తువు యొక్క ప్రతిబింబం ఆ వస్తువుతో పోలిస్తే ఎంత పెద్దదిగా లేదా చిన్నదిగా కనిపిస్తుందో తెలిపే కొలత.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ఆవర్ధనం యొక్క సూత్రం: M = v/u, ఇక్కడ: \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • M అనేది ఆవర్ధనం,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • v అనేది ప్రతిబింబ దూరం (దృశ్య కేంద్రం నుండి ప్రతిబింబం యొక్క దూరం),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • u అనేది వస్తువు దూరం (దృశ్య కేంద్రం నుండి వస్తువు యొక్క దూరం).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • సరైన ఎంపిక: ఆవర్ధనం = v/u.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ఆవర్ధనం ఇలా ఉండవచ్చు: \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ధనాత్మకం: ప్రతిబింబం నిటారుగా ఉన్నప్పుడు (మిథ్యా ప్రతిబింబం).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • రుణాత్మకం: ప్రతిబింబం తలక్రిందులుగా ఉన్నప్పుడు (నిజ ప్రతిబింబం).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ఆవర్ధనం = u + v, ఆవర్ధనం = v × u, మరియు ఆవర్ధనం = u/v వంటి ఇతర ఎంపికలు సరైన గణిత సంబంధాన్ని సూచించవు కాబట్టి అవి తప్పు.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ఆవర్ధనం మరియు ప్రతిబింబం ఏర్పడటం: \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ఆవర్ధనం వస్తువుతో పోలిస్తే ప్రతిబింబం యొక్క సాపేక్ష పరిమాణం గురించి తెలియజేస్తుంది.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ఒకవేళ |M| > 1 అయితే, ప్రతిబింబం ఆవర్ధనం చెందుతుంది (వస్తువు కంటే పెద్దది).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ఒకవేళ |M| < 1 అయితే, ప్రతిబింబం క్షీణిస్తుంది (వస్తువు కంటే చిన్నది).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ఒకవేళ |M| = 1 అయితే, ప్రతిబింబం వస్తువు పరిమాణంలోనే ఉంటుంది.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ప్రతిబింబం యొక్క స్వభావం:\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • కుంభాకార కటకాలకు, నిజ మరియు తలక్రిందుల ప్రతిబింబం రుణాత్మక ఆవర్ధనాన్ని కలిగి ఉంటుంది.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • పుటాకార కటకాలకు, మిథ్యా మరియు నిటారు ప్రతిబింబం ధనాత్మక ఆవర్ధనాన్ని కలిగి ఉంటుంది.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • కటక సూత్రం: ఆవర్ధన సూత్రం కటక సూత్రంతో దగ్గరి సంబంధం కలిగి ఉంటుంది: 1/f = 1/v - 1/u, ఇక్కడ f అనేది కటకం యొక్క నాభ్యంతరం.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ఆవర్ధనం యొక్క ఉపయోగాలు:\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • చిన్న వస్తువులను పెద్దవిగా చేయడానికి సూక్ష్మదర్శినిలు, దూరదర్శినిలు మరియు భూతద్దాలలో ఉపయోగిస్తారు.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
